summary: First iteration end-to-end test of Smart Body (Persian RTL sports platform). Ran 19 pytest backend tests (all pass) covering catalog, gyms search (Persian normalization for چهارباغ/چهار باغ, generic-word stripping so 'فردوسی' in همدان returns empty), sport filter, uploads (image + non-image 400), and registrations (valid Persian phone, invalid phone, unknown city, empty sports, unknown imagePath). Ran Playwright UI checks on desktop and mobile 390px: homepage loads, theme-toggle switches html.dark and persists via sb-theme localStorage, hero empty-city error shows, city combobox (city-option-hamedan) + location input + submit navigates to /search?city=همدان&q=بوعلی and renders gym-result-energy, sport-filter-yoga updates URL, /gym/energy shows name+call+related arya, /register shows validation errors on empty submit, /admin lists the created TEST_ registration, mobile has no horizontal overflow and mobile-menu opens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: startup uses deprecated @app.on_event; consider FastAPI lifespan handler (non-blocking).
server.py upload route: file.read() is unbounded before size check; a client could send huge payload. Consider streaming or checking Content-Length first.
server.py: no rate limiting on /api/uploads or /api/registrations - could be spam target; fine for prototype but flag for prod.
storage.init_storage stores key in module global; retry-on-404 is good but no lock (fine in FastAPI single-process).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test registration 'TEST_باشگاه نمونه' via POST /api/registrations (kept as instructed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header nav uses data-testid='nav-link-{id}' (not nav-{id}). City combobox is Popover + cmdk (click search-city-select then city-option-{slug}). Backend index on gyms.slug + upsert on startup makes seeded data idempotent. Uploads route uses real object storage via Emergent integration proxy - it's reachable in this env. Test creates a TEST_ registration that persists across runs.
